title: SafeLink
tagline: Send Crypto to next billion people using Links
description:
One enduring problem in the rapidly changing Web3 and cryptocurrency ecosystem is the onboarding process. Even when giving cryptocurrency to friends, exchanging long hexadecimal wallet addresses is a burdensome activity. This is not only annoying, but it also puts people who are unfamiliar with decentralised finance at a disadvantage.

Presenting SafeLink, a revolutionary technology that has been painstakingly designed to get around these obstacles and make cryptocurrency transactions incredibly simple. You won't have to ask your friends for their complicated wallet addresses any more. It becomes as easy as clicking when you use SafeLink. With the help of SafeAuth and Safe Wallets' potent synergy, we have completely redesigned how consumers interact with cryptocurrencies.

SafeLink introduces an elegant and intuitive interface, ensuring a seamless experience for  users. Sign in effortlessly with Google through SafeAuth, and witness the automatic creation of Safe Wallets.
how_its_made: We didn't get enough time to complete the project, the concept has been captured theoretically but implementations are still in progress.
